newsitem.title: UK: Cortworth says agreed offer from BI Group.
newsitem.headline: Cortworth says agreed offer from BI Group.

text.p: British specialist engineering and plastics group Cortworth Plc said on Friday that it had agreed a take-over offer from BI Group Plc.
The offer of 196 pence per share values Cortworth's at around 93.6 million stg.
It represents a premium of over 25 percent to Cortworth's share price of 156 pence at close of business on Thursday.
BI, a direct wholly owned subsidiary of NIC Holdings Plc, has received acceptance representing approximately 40 percent of the issued share capital of Cortworth.
BI said the acquisition represented an exceptional opportunity to acquire complementary and individually strong businesses that will significantly enhance the core activities of the company.
The acquisition of Cortworth was consistent with the management's wish to grow the group's competences in metal forming/finishing and plastics technologies, the company said.
Cortworth said tyhe offer represented good value for shareholders.
